Sprint/Agent03.title: Unguarded enrichment of the forward prefix abstraction gains nothing; 196's prefix state lies on a cycle (k = 3..7)
Sprint/Agent03.scope: Two statements about the k-column forward prefix abstraction (forwardPrefix with inner carry 0 or 1). (1) For any extra state X and any update δ : X → List Nat → Nat → X that never blocks a carry, the words of the least enriched invariant are exactly Reach w0 (proj_iff), and any enriched forward-closed set containing the start covers every Reach-word (enriched_invariant_covers, no_new_exclusion); this covers residues mod 99, width mod m, time mod 6 and the previous carry. (2) A word on a forward cycle, and every word forward-reachable from it, has no rank under any RowsClosed k rank function (rank_none_of_cycle, no_rank_of_cycleOK); the width-k projection of orbit 196 100 lies on such a cycle for k = 3..7 (kernel-checked carry witnesses), so no width-k batch entry for a k-digit prefix in its forward closure can pass entryOK (entryOK_false_3 .. entryOK_false_7). Not claimed: anything about palindromes of 196, that the forward closure equals the infinite-rank region (that was only computed), or anything at k ≥ 8.
